title: IMASUS App: a configurable platform for collaborative workshops
description:
IMASUS App is a configurable open-source Rails platform for collaborative workshops, with installation-owned branding, languages, resource modules, and multilingual content.

Munkun SL conceived, designed, and developed the software platform created for the IMASUS project. The materials research was carried out by the Institute of Nanoscience and Materials of Aragón (INMA). The research underpinning the training modules and challenges was carried out by Lottozero.

The platform was developed through the EU-funded IMASUS project under Erasmus+ grant 2024-1-ES01-KA220-VET-000257495.
